blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Condos in Brentwood Park. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats). No building list, strata fees, street boundaries or live listing feed filtered to this home type yet.

Brentwood Park condos in Burnaby: The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so the figures on this page cover both and cannot be split until Jared’s sold-listing export is added. 360 condos and townhomes were listed at the end of September 2026 and 39 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. That makes Brentwood Park number 1 of 35 Burnaby communities by condo and townhome listings.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo and townhome listings in Brentwood Park was little changed, 362 in June and 360 in September (−0.6%), while 198 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 27.0% of Burnaby’s 1,333 condo and townhome listings.
Condos or houses in Brentwood Park?
Brentwood Park also had 21 houses listed and 3 sold in September, against 360 condos and townhomes listed. The houses page has the detached figures and the guide covers the neighbourhood.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Brentwood Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the reports showed 360 condos and townhomes listed in Brentwood Park. That is a month-end count and moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Brentwood Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos?
faq.a: In September 2026 condos and townhomes in Brentwood Park had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos sold in Brentwood Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 198 condos and townhomes sold over those 4 months, out of 750 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so the figures on this page cover both and cannot be split until Jared’s sold-listing export is added.

faq.q: Where are the Brentwood Park houses and townhomes?
faq.a: Houses and townhomes each have their own page, and the Brentwood Park guide covers the neighbourhood as a whole.
